content: Hello! how can I help today?
I just received restricted stock from my startup. Should I make an 83(b) election?

You should file an **§83(b) election within 30 days** of grant to lock in **ordinary income** at today’s low value and convert future appreciation to **capital gain**. This is the standard move when FMV is minimal.
How do I file it correctly?

1) Prepare and sign the election letter with grant date, shares, FMV, and amount paid.
2) **Mail** it to the IRS within 30 days (track delivery).
3) Provide a copy to your employer.
4) Keep the IRS-stamped copy in your records.
Yes—the bargain element is included on your **W-2** for the grant year. No later refunds if shares are forfeited, which is why timing the election when value is low is ideal.
